en-US.name: Rea-Video
en-US.shortDesc: Analyze how a video was made shot by shot, from live action to AI and motion graphics. Get a VIDEO.md package and an HTML report. Requires the Rea-Video CLI, Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg. Optional visual analysis and remake services require separate setup and may incur fees.

zh-CN.name: Rea-Video 视频拆解
zh-CN.shortDesc: 逐镜拆解视频的制作方式、剪辑包装和声音，生成 VIDEO.md 拆片包和 HTML 报告。需另装 Rea-Video CLI、Python 3.10+ 和 FFmpeg。视觉模型和复刻服务可选，需单独配置，可能收费。
